note: Single source of truth for the hub. id = legacy slug(name): play counts are keyed by it, never rename.

games.name: Blackjack
games.blurb: A six-deck table with play-money chips. Blackjack pays 3:2, dealer stands on soft 17, split up to four hands.

games.name: Pool
games.blurb: English pub pool with reds and yellows. Play bots from Easy to Pro, pass and play, or send a friend a link and play online. Pub rules or Blackball.

games.name: Kart Racer
games.blurb: 3D kart racing on eight tracks, five outdoor and three indoor. Apex GP-style steering, drift boosts, karts you paint yourself, and races against bots or friends online.
games.keywords: car cars kart drive driving race

games.name: Geometry Dash Replica
games.blurb: Jump, fly and flip to the beat. Practice modes, a shop, a level editor and an online leaderboard.

games.name: Bloons TD 6 Replica
games.blurb: Pop every bloon before it gets through. 21 monkeys with full upgrade paths, six heroes, 12 maps and rounds up to 100 and beyond.

games.name: Flappy Bird Replica
games.blurb: The 2013 original, pixel for pixel. Tap to flap through the pipes, chase medals, or work through ten levels from Breezy to Demon.

games.name: Space Invaders Extreme
games.blurb: The neon remix: chain four of a colour for bombs, lasers and spreads, win UFO rounds for Fever, and take on five bosses to a pounding beat. Solo or co-op.

games.name: Pong
games.blurb: The 1972 Atari classic. Beat the CPU on three difficulties, play a friend on one screen, or go online with a room code.

games.name: Tetris
games.blurb: The falling-block puzzle done the modern way: 7-bag, SRS rotation, hold, ghost piece, T-spins and back-to-backs, Marathon and a 40-line sprint.

games.name: Snake
games.blurb: Eat the apple, grow, and don't bite your own tail. Smooth gliding movement, buffered turns for tight U-turns, three board sizes and three speeds.

games.name: Pac-Man
games.blurb: The 1980 maze, all 240 dots. Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde hunt with their real arcade personalities, scatter and chase on the original timers.
Slide, merge, reach 2048. Classic colours and animations, plus undo, board sizes from 3x3 to 6x6, and your game survives a refresh.

games.name: Minesweeper
games.blurb: The Windows classic, grey bevels and all. Safe first click, chording, Beginner to Expert plus custom boards, and best times per level.

games.name: Solitaire
games.blurb: Klondike, the most-played computer game ever. Drag or tap to move, Draw 1 or Draw 3, unlimited undo, hints, auto-finish and the bouncing-card win.

games.name: Wordle
games.blurb: Six tries to find the five-letter word. A daily puzzle everyone shares, an unlimited mode, hard mode, stats and an emoji grid to share.

games.name: Sudoku
games.blurb: Fresh puzzles with exactly one solution, Easy to Expert plus a daily. Pencil notes, hints that explain themselves, undo and best times.

games.name: Breakout
games.blurb: Smash the wall. The 1976 Atari rules in Classic, plus an Arcade mode with shaped levels, steel bricks, lasers, multi-ball and fireballs.

games.name: Asteroids
games.blurb: The 1979 vector classic. Thrust, wrap and blast rocks into smaller rocks, dodge the saucers, and put your initials on the high score table.

games.name: Dino Run
games.blurb: Chrome's offline T-Rex, rebuilt. Jump the cacti, duck the pterodactyls, and see how far you get before night falls.

games.name: Drift Boss
games.blurb: Hold to drift round the next corner of a zig-zag road in the sky. One button, one mistake and you are off the edge.

games.name: Doodle Jump
games.blurb: Bounce up a sheet of graph paper on springs, moving and breaking platforms. Dodge the monsters and keep climbing.

games.name: Crossy Road
games.blurb: Hop a voxel chicken across busy roads, rivers of logs and train tracks. How far can you get before the eagle?
games.keywords: chicken road cross hop cars trains voxel

games.name: Stickman Hook
games.blurb: Swing from hook to hook, let go at the right moment and fly to the finish. Dozens of levels of rope physics.

games.name: Connect 4
games.blurb: Drop discs, line up four. Play a bot from easy to expert, pass and play, or send a friend a link and play online.
games.keywords: four in a row discs board

games.name: Candy Match
games.blurb: Swap sweets to match three or more. Striped, wrapped and colour-bomb candies, cascades and a map of levels to clear.

games.name: Boggle
games.blurb: Shake the letter cubes and find as many words as you can before the timer runs out. Solo, daily board or race a CPU.

games.name: Tic Tac Toe
games.blurb: Neon noughts and crosses. Beat the computer on Easy or Medium, try to draw against Impossible, or play a friend on the same device or online.

games.name: Cookie Clicker
games.blurb: Click the big cookie, hire grandmas, build farms, factories and portals, catch golden cookies and bake trillions.

games.name: Block Blast
games.blurb: Drag blocks onto an 8×8 board, fill rows and columns to blast them and chain combos for a high score.

games.name: Chess
games.blurb: The full game of kings. Take on the computer at Easy, Medium or Hard, play a friend on the same device, or play online with a room code or quick match.

games.name: Fruit Ninja
games.blurb: Swipe to slice flying fruit, chain combos and dodge the bombs. Classic, Arcade and Zen modes.

games.name: Subway Surfers
games.blurb: Dash down the subway tracks in 3D. Dodge oncoming trains, jump hurdles, roll under barriers and grab coins.

games.name: Wreck Run
games.blurb: Two minutes, one hatchback, a whole town of cones, bins, gnomes and pianos to smash. Combos, drifts, jumps and a world leaderboard.

games.name: Nosy Neighbour
games.blurb: Five stealth levels: sneak into his basement, escape his cold cellar, rob the new neighbour on your street, break into a huge mansion, then survive the Nightmare House with its tram and Fear rooms.
games.keywords: neighbour neighbor stealth house basement horror

games.name: Getting Over It
games.blurb: A man in a pot, a sledgehammer and a 100 metre mountain. No checkpoints. Falling is part of the deal.

games.name: BlockForge
games.blurb: An endless voxel world to mine and build in, with day and night, water, caves, shaders and touch controls.
games.keywords: voxel mine build craft blocks sandbox

games.name: Apex GP
games.blurb: First-person Formula racing. Ten teams, three circuits, DRS and ERS, pit stops, and multiplayer with friends.
games.keywords: f1 formula car race grand prix

games.name: 2 Weeks
games.blurb: Build-and-shoot battle royale on an island. Drop from the bus, farm, build, loot and outlast 24 bots and the storm.
games.keywords: battle royale build shoot island storm

games.name: Nosy Neighbor V2
games.blurb: The rebuilt Nosy Neighbor. Sneak into Mr. Grimsby's house, dodge him room by room and find out what he is hiding. Work in progress, updated as each milestone lands.
games.keywords: neighbor neighbour nosy house grimsby stealth sneak explore 3d v2

games.name: The Humanizer
games.blurb: Paste AI-written text, get back something that reads like a person wrote it. Checks itself against AI detectors.

games.name: Retro Bowl
games.blurb: Coach a pixel-art football team: sling passes, juke tacklers, kick field goals, then manage the roster all the way to the Retro Bowl.
games.keywords: american football nfl quarterback touchdown coach season franchise sports

games.name: Trap Race
games.blurb: 2–6 player party platformer. Draft one item each round, bolt it onto a shared course, then race to the flag through everyone's traps. Online rooms or bots, desktop or phone.
games.keywords: trap race party platformer build obstacle course draft sniper cannon black hole wall jump multiplayer friends bots ultimate chicken horse

games.name: FNAF Replica
games.blurb: Co-op night-guard survival for up to four. Hold the office with doors, lights and cameras, or walk the whole pizzeria in free roam: restore the power, hide, and last until 6 AM.
games.keywords: fnaf five nights freddy horror security guard office cameras doors animatronics pizzeria free roam co-op night shift
